In this setting the door can be opened by speaking the Word of Passage ("Quietus") or by using the correct key; other attempts can trigger alarms or traps, though in this moment the door is already safely open. The chamber beyond contains tomb features (bronze plaques, trapped mechanisms and trial-like puzzles) that may hold inscriptions or hints but haven't been fully examined yet.
